book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 3 Delving into History 深入历史
source: 上外版选必四 Unit 3 词表(大运河/丝绸之路 真词);IPA 英音标准词典回填;例句原创、历史/运河/丝路主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The Grand Canal became the lifeline of the whole empire.
words.example_cn: 大运河成了整个帝国的命脉。

words.example_en: The canal helped to promote the economy of the empire.
words.example_cn: 运河帮助促进了帝国的经济。

words.example_en: The expansion of the railway slowly replaced the old canal.
words.example_cn: 铁路的扩展慢慢取代了古老的运河。

words.example_en: Salt became an important source of income during the Ming dynasty.
words.example_cn: 盐在明朝成了重要的收入来源。

words.example_en: The Silk Road was a famous trade route between East and West.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路是连接东西方的著名贸易路线。

words.example_en: Many goods left from the busy port cities along the coast.
words.example_cn: 许多货物从沿海繁忙的港口城市运出。

words.example_en: Suzhou grew to thrive as a centre of trade along the canal.
words.example_cn: 苏州发展成运河沿线繁荣的贸易中心。

words.example_en: The canal proved a powerful tool for moving grain north.
words.example_cn: 运河被证明是向北运粮的有力工具。

words.example_en: Thousands of soldiers were needed to operate the canal boats.
words.example_cn: 需要数千名士兵来驾驶运河上的船只。

words.example_en: The main aim of the project is to move water to dry regions.
words.example_cn: 这一工程的主要目标是把水调往干旱地区。

words.example_en: The project will divert water from the south to the north.
words.example_cn: 这项工程将把南方的水调往北方。

words.example_en: Water is carried to the arid regions of the north every year.
words.example_cn: 每年都有水被输送到北方干旱的地区。

words.example_en: The legendary Silk Road linked China with distant lands.
words.example_cn: 传奇的丝绸之路把中国与遥远的国度连接起来。

words.example_en: Istanbul was seen as the gateway to Europe on the Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 伊斯坦布尔被视为丝绸之路上通往欧洲的门户。

words.example_en: The trade in silk boomed along the entire length of the road.
words.example_cn: 丝绸贸易沿整条道路迅速发展。

words.example_en: Silk was the most valuable commodity traded from China.
words.example_cn: 丝绸是中国出口的最珍贵的商品。

words.example_en: The trade routes grew into a complex network of paths.
words.example_cn: 这些贸易路线发展成一张复杂的路网。

words.example_en: Zhang Qian's journeys paved the way for trade with the West.
words.example_cn: 张骞的出使为同西方的贸易铺平了道路。

words.example_en: His missions opened the way for diplomatic exchanges between states.
words.example_cn: 他的出使为各国间的外交往来开辟了道路。

words.example_en: The Silk Road encouraged commercial exchanges across many lands.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路促进了许多国家之间的商业往来。

words.example_en: Traders carried goods between the Middle Kingdom and the West.
words.example_cn: 商人在中国与西方之间运送货物。

words.example_en: The road also became a channel for religious thought.
words.example_cn: 这条道路也成了宗教思想传播的通道。

words.example_en: The Silk Road was an efficient way to spread new ideas.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路是传播新思想的高效途径。

words.example_en: The Silk Road was a kind of ancient version of the information highway.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路是信息高速公路的一种古代版本。

words.example_en: The Chinese traded fine porcelain, tea and gold with the West.
words.example_cn: 中国人用精美的瓷器、茶叶和黄金同西方交易。

words.example_en: Asian skills and crafts were shared along the Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 亚洲的技艺和工艺沿丝绸之路得到分享。

words.example_en: The skill of spinning silk thread spread westward along the road.
words.example_cn: 纺丝的技艺沿这条路向西传播。

words.example_en: Iron casting was one of the crafts introduced to the West.
words.example_cn: 铸铁是传入西方的工艺之一。

words.example_en: Workers learned to cast iron and make strong tools.
words.example_cn: 工人们学会了铸铁并制作坚固的工具。

words.example_en: Music and dance performances from Central Asia were popular in China.
words.example_cn: 来自中亚的音乐舞蹈表演在中国很受欢迎。

words.example_en: The shows often featured dancers and musicians in colourful masks.
words.example_cn: 这些演出常以戴着彩色面具的舞者和乐师为特色。

words.example_en: In agriculture, grapes and walnuts were brought to China from the west.
words.example_cn: 在农业方面,葡萄和核桃从西方传入中国。

words.example_en: Scholars call the sea routes the Maritime Silk Road.
words.example_cn: 学者把这些海上路线称为海上丝绸之路。

words.example_en: Ships left the coastal ports of southeast China and sailed far away.
words.example_cn: 船只从中国东南沿海的港口出发,航行到远方。

words.example_en: The ships sailed through the Strait of Malacca on their way west.
words.example_cn: 船只在西行途中穿过马六甲海峡。

words.example_en: The boats reached distant destinations as far away as India.
words.example_cn: 这些船只到达了远至印度的目的地。

words.example_en: The sea route reached as far as the Indian Peninsula.
words.example_cn: 这条海路远达印度半岛。

words.example_en: Countries along the routes gained much more than material goods.
words.example_cn: 沿线国家获得的远不止物质货物。

words.example_en: The Silk Road brought more than just material goods to the world.
words.example_cn: 丝绸之路给世界带来的不只是物质货物。

words.example_en: The road brought about an invaluable exchange of culture.
words.example_cn: 这条路带来了极其宝贵的文化交流。

words.example_en: The Grand Canal became the economic lifeline of the empire.
words.example_cn: 大运河成了帝国的经济命脉。

words.example_en: Never before had such a large-scale canal project been attempted.
words.example_cn: 此前从未尝试过如此大规模的运河工程。

words.example_en: Goods sent from the north included cotton, wool and coal.
words.example_cn: 从北方运来的货物包括棉布、毛料和煤。

words.example_en: Wool was carried south while grain was carried north.
words.example_cn: 毛料被运往南方,而粮食被运往北方。

words.example_en: Thousands of government barges travelled along this route each year.
words.example_cn: 每年有数千艘官府驳船沿这条线路航行。

words.example_en: Many port cities thrived, chief among them Suzhou.
words.example_cn: 许多港口城市繁荣起来,其中以苏州为首。

words.example_en: The routes were not restricted to land but also crossed the sea.
words.example_cn: 这些路线不限于陆地,也跨越海洋。

words.example_en: The routes became a two-way movement of trade and ideas.
words.example_cn: 这些路线成了贸易与思想的双向流动。
